function: Symbol detection by a CNN refining message-passing outputs, within joint device identification, channel estimation, and detection for OTFS LEO satellite random access (pp. 10-11).
system: U=40 single-antenna IoT devices; LEO satellite with 4x4 UPA (16 antennas); OTFS, S-band, 30 kHz subcarrier spacing; no RIS (pp. 3, 12).
method: Complex-valued residual CNN (8 residual blocks), supervised with cross-entropy loss and Adam, applied to outputs of non-learned MRF-MP-GAMP; EM only tunes hyperparameters (pp. 10-12).
data_channel: Own simulator with NTN-TDL-D power delay profile (3GPP TR 38.811), Rician factor 11.707 dB; 8,000 training, 2,000 validation, 2,000 test samples (p. 12).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on one simulated scenario (held-out 2,000 samples); training SNR, activity, frames not stated; test sweeps SNR, frames Q, device activity (pp. 12-14).
baselines: ConvSBL-GAMP+MP, GMMV-AMP+GAMP, Oracle-LMMSE, all non-learned; no learned baseline; own MRF-MP-GAMP without CNN as ablation (p. 12).
metrics: Activity error rate, NMSE, and symbol error rate, versus SNR, number of frames, and device activity (pp. 12-14).
complexity: Order O(QUM^2N^2Na + |A|QM^2NNa + Pbar^3) for the MRF-MP-GAMP stage; no FLOPs, parameters, or runtime for the CNN (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 12: "The power delay profile of TSL follows the NTN-TDL-D [20]"; p. 16 lists [20] as 3GPP TR 38.811. Only the profile and Rician factor come from 3GPP.
q2_support: p. 12: "8,000 samples for training, 2,000 for validation, and 2,000 for testing" is a held-out split of the same data; no unseen scenario, band, or user number is stated.
q3_support: p. 12: benchmarks "ConvSBL-GAMP+MP", "GMMV-AMP+GAMP", "Oracle-LMMSE" are non-learned; no earlier learned detector is compared, and MRF-MP-GAMP-CNN versus MRF-MP-GAMP is an ablation.
q4_support: p. 10: "the total complexity of the MRF-MP-GAMP algorithm is in the order of O(" with terms in Q, U, M, N, Na, |A|; the CNN cost is not given.
q5_support: p. 12: "datasets are generated with 8,000 samples for training" from the paper's own simulation; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Included because a trained CNN (Sec. IV, pp. 10-11) performs symbol detection; the main receiver MRF-MP-GAMP is a non-learned Bayesian message-passing algorithm with EM. Area 4: OTFS delay-Doppler channel estimation and detection for LEO. q1 to confirm: only the power delay profile and Rician factor come from TR 38.811 (NTN-TDL-D); delays, Dopplers, and angles follow the paper's own geometry (Table I, p. 12). q4 to confirm: the complexity order covers the message-passing stage only; the CNN has an architecture table (Table II, p. 12) but no FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime. q2: p. 2 says the CNN can "adapt to the dynamic number of active devices" and Fig. 8 (p. 14) sweeps device activity, but the training activity is never stated, so it is not met.
